#load data
```{r load-data}
library(qs)
library(Seurat)
library(Matrix)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(furrr)

source("/path/to/scRhythmBayes/reproducibility/support/legacy/infer_cell_phase.R")
source("/path/to/scRhythmBayes/R/infer_gene_param.R")
source("/path/to/scRhythmBayes/reproducibility/support/legacy/infer_ovr_rhythm_clean.R")

scliver_file <- "/path/to/data_volume/scRhythmBayes/data/scCircadianLiver-RNAonly.qs"
out_dir <- "/path/to/data_volume/scRhythmBayes/data/revised_liver_full"
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
input_cache_file <- file.path(out_dir, "liver_count_meta_cache.qs")
input_cache <- if (file.exists(input_cache_file)) tryCatch(qread(input_cache_file), error = function(e) NULL) else NULL
if (is.list(input_cache) && all(c("count_mat", "meta") %in% names(input_cache))) {
  count_mat <- input_cache$count_mat; meta <- input_cache$meta; rm(input_cache)
} else {
  scliver <- qread(scliver_file); DefaultAssay(scliver) <- "RNA"
  count_mat <- GetAssayData(scliver, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts"); meta <- scliver@meta.data
  input_cache_tmp <- paste0(input_cache_file, ".tmp"); qsave(list(count_mat = count_mat, meta = meta), input_cache_tmp, preset = "balanced"); if (!file.rename(input_cache_tmp, input_cache_file)) stop("Failed to finalize count/meta cache")
  rm(scliver); gc(full = TRUE)
}
meta$cell <- rownames(meta)
meta$ZT_num <- readr::parse_number(as.character(meta$ZT))
```

#main version
```{r main-ovr, eval=FALSE}
res_phase <- infer_cell_phase(count = count_mat,
                              metadata = meta,
                              ZT_by = "ZT_num",
                              strata_by = "celltype",
                              Species = "mouse",
                              setseed = 1,
                              Verbose = TRUE)

saveRDS(res_phase, file.path(out_dir, "liver_phase.rds"))

res_param <- infer_gene_param(count = count_mat,
                              metadata = meta,
                              theta_pred = res_phase$theta_pred,
                              r_cell = res_phase$r_cell,
                              strata_by = "celltype",
                              B = 100,
                              n_worker = 10,
                              setseed = 1,
                              sample_by = NULL,
                              Verbose = TRUE)

saveRDS(res_param, file.path(out_dir, "liver_gene_param.rds"))

ovr_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "ovr_clean")
dir.create(ovr_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

celltypes <- sort(unique(as.character(meta$celltype)))

for (ct in celltypes) {
  ct_file <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", ct)
  out_file <- file.path(ovr_dir, paste0("OVR_", ct_file, "_vs_Rest.rds"))

  if (file.exists(out_file)) {
    message("Skip completed: ", ct)
    next
  }

  res_one <- infer_ovr_rhythm(count = count_mat,
                              metadata = meta,
                              theta_pred = res_phase$theta_pred,
                              r_cell = res_phase$r_cell,
                              group_by = "celltype",
                              target_groups = ct,
                              q_cut = 0.05,
                              amp_cut = 0.25,
                              n_worker = 10,
                              setseed = 1,
                              Verbose = TRUE,
                              sample_by = NULL,
                              B = 1)

  saveRDS(res_one, out_file)
  message("Saved: ", ct)
  rm(res_one)
  gc()
}

ovr_list <- lapply(celltypes, function(ct) readRDS(file.path(ovr_dir, paste0("OVR_", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", ct), "_vs_Rest.rds"))))
names(ovr_list) <- celltypes

ovr_result <- bind_rows(lapply(ovr_list, function(x) x$ovr_result))
ovr_markers <- bind_rows(lapply(ovr_list, function(x) x$ovr_markers))
ovr_summary <- ovr_markers %>% count(celltype, name = "n_marker") %>% right_join(data.frame(celltype = celltypes), by = "celltype") %>% mutate(n_marker = ifelse(is.na(n_marker), 0L, n_marker)) %>% arrange(match(celltype, celltypes))

res_ovr <- list(ovr_result = ovr_result,
                ovr_markers = ovr_markers,
                ovr_summary = ovr_summary)

saveRDS(res_ovr, file.path(out_dir, "liver_ovr_clean.rds"))
write.csv(ovr_markers, file.path(out_dir, "liver_ovr_clean_markers.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(ovr_summary, file.path(out_dir, "liver_ovr_clean_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

res_ovr$ovr_summary
```

# LOCO
```{r loco, eval=FALSE}
# LOCO
loco_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "ovr_loco")
dir.create(loco_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

for (ct in celltypes) {
  for (leave_ct in setdiff(celltypes, ct)) {

    cells_use <- meta$cell[meta$celltype != leave_ct]
    count_use <- count_mat[, cells_use, drop = FALSE]
    meta_use <- meta[cells_use, , drop = FALSE]
    phase_id <- match(cells_use, res_phase$cell)

    res_loco <- infer_ovr_rhythm(count = count_use,
                                 metadata = meta_use,
                                 theta_pred = res_phase$theta_pred[phase_id],
                                 r_cell = res_phase$r_cell[phase_id],
                                 group_by = "celltype",
                                 target_groups = ct,
                                 q_cut = 0.05,
                                 amp_cut = 0.25,
                                 n_worker = 10,
                                 setseed = 1,
                                 Verbose = TRUE,
                                 sample_by = NULL,
                                 B = 1)

    ct_file <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", ct)
    leave_file <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", leave_ct)

    saveRDS(res_loco, file.path(loco_dir, paste0("LOCO_", ct_file, "_leave_", leave_file, ".rds")))

    rm(res_loco, count_use, meta_use)
    gc()
  }
}
```

# pairwise
```{r pairwise, eval=FALSE}

pairwise_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "ovr_pairwise")
dir.create(pairwise_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

for (i in 1:(length(celltypes) - 1)) {
  for (j in (i + 1):length(celltypes)) {

    ct1 <- celltypes[i]
    ct2 <- celltypes[j]

    cells_use <- meta$cell[meta$celltype %in% c(ct1, ct2)]
    count_use <- count_mat[, cells_use, drop = FALSE]
    meta_use <- meta[cells_use, , drop = FALSE]
    phase_id <- match(cells_use, res_phase$cell)

    res_pair <- infer_ovr_rhythm(count = count_use,
                                 metadata = meta_use,
                                 theta_pred = res_phase$theta_pred[phase_id],
                                 r_cell = res_phase$r_cell[phase_id],
                                 group_by = "celltype",
                                 target_groups = c(ct1, ct2),
                                 q_cut = 0.05,
                                 amp_cut = 0.25,
                                 n_worker = 10,
                                 setseed = 1,
                                 Verbose = TRUE,
                                 sample_by = NULL,
                                 B = 1)

    ct1_file <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", ct1)
    ct2_file <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", ct2)

    saveRDS(res_pair, file.path(pairwise_dir, paste0("PAIR_", ct1_file, "_vs_", ct2_file, ".rds")))

    rm(res_pair, count_use, meta_use)
    gc()
  }
}
```



```{r collect-results, eval=FALSE}
loco_files <- list.files(loco_dir, pattern = "\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)

loco_result <- NULL

for (f in loco_files) {
  x <- readRDS(f)
  x$ovr_result$comparison <- basename(f)
  loco_result <- bind_rows(loco_result, x$ovr_result)
}

loco_markers <- loco_result %>% filter(ovr_marker)

saveRDS(loco_result, file.path(out_dir, "liver_ovr_loco_all.rds"))
write.csv(loco_markers, file.path(out_dir, "liver_ovr_loco_markers.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

pairwise_files <- list.files(pairwise_dir, pattern = "\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)

pairwise_result <- NULL

for (f in pairwise_files) {
  x <- readRDS(f)
  x$ovr_result$comparison <- basename(f)
  pairwise_result <- bind_rows(pairwise_result, x$ovr_result)
}

pairwise_markers <- pairwise_result %>% filter(ovr_marker)

saveRDS(pairwise_result, file.path(out_dir, "liver_ovr_pairwise_all.rds"))
write.csv(pairwise_markers, file.path(out_dir, "liver_ovr_pairwise_markers.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

# OVR Figure B--F
## Shared input + panel B

```{r figure-input-panel-B}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(tibble); library(readr); library(ggplot2); library(stringr)
})

ovr_force_recompute <- FALSE
ovr_allow_findall_recompute <- FALSE
ovr_force_export <- FALSE
ovr_heatmap_workers <- 1L
ovr_export_cairo <- FALSE
ovr_export_tiff_600 <- FALSE
options(future.globals.maxSize = 2 * 1024^3)

ovr_data_dir <- "/path/to/scRhythmBayes/data"
baseline_dir <- file.path(ovr_data_dir, "ovr_baseline")
loco_file <- file.path(ovr_data_dir, "liver_ovr_loco_all.rds")
loco_summary_file <- file.path(ovr_data_dir, "liver_ovr_loco_summary.csv")
figure_dir <- file.path(ovr_data_dir, "ovr_figure_revision")
dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

baseline_files <- list.files(baseline_dir, pattern = "[.]rds$", full.names = TRUE)
stopifnot(length(baseline_files) == 7L, file.exists(loco_file), file.exists(loco_summary_file))
baseline_list <- setNames(lapply(baseline_files, readRDS), basename(baseline_files))
baseline_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(baseline_list, function(x) x$ovr_result))
baseline_markers <- baseline_all %>% dplyr::filter(ovr_marker) %>% dplyr::distinct(celltype, gene, .keep_all = TRUE)
loco_all <- readRDS(loco_file)
loco_summary_saved <- read_csv(loco_summary_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
stopifnot(all(c("gene", "celltype", "Phase_target", "FDR_target", "FDR_rest", "ovr_marker") %in% names(baseline_all)))
stopifnot(all(c("gene", "celltype", "left_out_celltype", "ovr_marker") %in% names(loco_all)))

loco_expected <- loco_all %>% dplyr::distinct(celltype, left_out_celltype) %>% dplyr::count(celltype, name = "n_expected_loco")
stopifnot(all(loco_expected$n_expected_loco == 6L))
loco_support <- loco_all %>% dplyr::group_by(celltype, gene) %>% dplyr::summarise(n_tested_loco = dplyr::n_distinct(left_out_celltype), support_n = sum(ovr_marker, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
baseline_stability <- baseline_markers %>% dplyr::left_join(loco_support, by = c("celltype", "gene")) %>% dplyr::left_join(loco_expected, by = "celltype") %>% dplyr::mutate(n_tested_loco = dplyr::coalesce(n_tested_loco, 0L), support_n = dplyr::coalesce(support_n, 0L), support_group = dplyr::case_when(support_n == 6L ~ "6/6", support_n == 5L ~ "5/6", support_n == 4L ~ "4/6", TRUE ~ "<=3/6"), support_group = factor(support_group, levels = c("<=3/6", "4/6", "5/6", "6/6")))
celltype_order <- baseline_stability %>% dplyr::count(celltype, name = "n_marker") %>% dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n_marker), celltype) %>% dplyr::pull(celltype)
panel_b_df <- baseline_stability %>% dplyr::count(celltype, support_group, name = "n_marker") %>% tidyr::complete(celltype, support_group, fill = list(n_marker = 0L)) %>% dplyr::mutate(celltype = factor(celltype, levels = rev(celltype_order)))
panel_b_total <- baseline_stability %>% dplyr::count(celltype, name = "n_marker") %>% dplyr::mutate(celltype = factor(celltype, levels = rev(celltype_order)))
panel_b_check <- baseline_stability %>% dplyr::group_by(celltype) %>% dplyr::summarise(n_baseline = dplyr::n(), n_stable_6_of_6 = sum(support_n == 6L), n_stable_5_of_6 = sum(support_n >= 5L), median_stability = median(support_n / n_expected_loco), .groups = "drop") %>% dplyr::left_join(loco_summary_saved, by = "celltype", suffix = c("_recomputed", "_saved"))

celltype_levels <- c("Hep.PV", "Hep.CV", "Kupffer cells", "Fibroblasts", "Endothelial", "Lymphocytes", "Cholangiocytes")
celltype_pal <- c("Hep.PV" = "#E84D33", "Hep.CV" = "#55B3CF", "Kupffer cells" = "#455A8B", "Fibroblasts" = "#9ED3C9", "Endothelial" = "#13A88E", "Lymphocytes" = "#F29C7E", "Cholangiocytes" = "#6A78A8")
stability_pal <- c("<=3/6" = "#D9D9D9", "4/6" = "#9ECAE1", "5/6" = "#4292C6", "6/6" = "#084594")
theme_ovr <- function(base_size = 11) theme_classic(base_size = base_size, base_family = "sans") + theme(axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.4), axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.4), plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5), legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"), panel.grid = element_blank())
save_gg <- function(p, stem, width, height, dpi = 300) {
  pdf_file <- paste0(stem, ".pdf"); cairo_file <- paste0(stem, "_cairo.pdf"); svg_file <- paste0(stem, ".svg"); png_file <- paste0(stem, ".png"); tiff_file <- paste0(stem, ".tiff")
  if (ovr_force_export || !file.exists(pdf_file)) ggsave(pdf_file, p, device = grDevices::pdf, width = width, height = height, units = "in", bg = "white", useDingbats = FALSE)
  if (ovr_export_cairo && (ovr_force_export || !file.exists(cairo_file))) ggsave(cairo_file, p, device = grDevices::cairo_pdf, width = width, height = height, units = "in", bg = "white")
  if (ovr_force_export || !file.exists(svg_file)) ggsave(svg_file, p, device = svglite::svglite, width = width, height = height, units = "in", bg = "white")
  if (ovr_force_export || !file.exists(png_file)) ggsave(png_file, p, device = ragg::agg_png, width = width, height = height, units = "in", dpi = dpi, bg = "white")
  if (ovr_export_tiff_600 && (ovr_force_export || !file.exists(tiff_file))) ggsave(tiff_file, p, device = ragg::agg_tiff, width = width, height = height, units = "in", dpi = 600, bg = "white", compression = "lzw")
}

write_tsv(baseline_all, file.path(figure_dir, "source_baseline_ovr_all.tsv.gz"))
write_tsv(baseline_stability, file.path(figure_dir, "source_baseline_marker_loco_support.tsv"))
write_tsv(panel_b_df, file.path(figure_dir, "panel_B_stability_counts.tsv"))
write_tsv(panel_b_check, file.path(figure_dir, "panel_B_saved_summary_check.tsv"))

p_B <- ggplot(panel_b_df, aes(x = n_marker, y = celltype, fill = support_group)) + geom_col(width = 0.72) + geom_text(data = panel_b_total, aes(x = n_marker, y = celltype, label = n_marker), inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = -0.25, size = 3.4) + scale_fill_manual(values = stability_pal, drop = FALSE, name = "LOCO support") + guides(fill = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)) + scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.10))) + labs(title = "Baseline OVR markers and LOCO robustness", x = "Baseline OVR marker count", y = NULL) + theme_ovr() + theme(axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold"), legend.position = "top")
print(p_B)
save_gg(p_B, file.path(figure_dir, "panel_B_baseline_LOCO_stacked_bar"), 7.2, 4.5)

plot_df_ovr <- baseline_markers %>% dplyr::count(celltype, name = "OVR_gene_count") %>% dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(OVR_gene_count)) %>% dplyr::mutate(celltype = factor(celltype, levels = celltype))
write_tsv(plot_df_ovr, file.path(figure_dir, "baseline_OVR_gene_count_by_celltype.tsv"))
p_gene_count <- ggplot(plot_df_ovr, aes(x = celltype, y = OVR_gene_count, fill = celltype)) + geom_col(width = 0.72) + geom_text(aes(label = OVR_gene_count), vjust = -0.35, size = 5, fontface = "bold") + scale_fill_manual(values = celltype_pal[levels(plot_df_ovr$celltype)], guide = "none") + scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.10))) + labs(title = "Baseline OVR marker count across cell types", x = "Cell type", y = "Gene count") + theme_bw() + theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 18), axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14), axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "bold", size = 11), axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12), panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
print(p_gene_count)
save_gg(p_gene_count, file.path(figure_dir, "panel_B_baseline_OVR_gene_count_barplot"), 8.2, 6)

upset_dir <- file.path(figure_dir, "baseline_OVR_UpSet_all7"); dir.create(upset_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
if (!requireNamespace("UpSetR", quietly = TRUE)) {
  message("UpSet plot skipped because package 'UpSetR' is not installed.")
} else {
  celltypes_all <- as.character(plot_df_ovr$celltype)
  gene_list <- setNames(lapply(celltypes_all, function(ct) sort(unique(baseline_markers$gene[baseline_markers$celltype == ct]))), celltypes_all)
  all_genes <- sort(unique(unlist(gene_list)))
  incidence_df <- tibble::tibble(gene = all_genes)
  for (ct in celltypes_all) incidence_df[[ct]] <- as.integer(all_genes %in% gene_list[[ct]])
  upset_df <- as.data.frame(incidence_df[, celltypes_all, drop = FALSE])
  saveRDS(gene_list, file.path(upset_dir, "baseline_OVR_all7_gene_list.rds")); write_tsv(incidence_df, file.path(upset_dir, "baseline_OVR_all7_incidence_matrix.tsv"))
  upset_obj <- UpSetR::upset(upset_df, sets = celltypes_all, keep.order = TRUE, order.by = "freq", nsets = length(celltypes_all), nintersects = NA, sets.bar.color = "grey35", main.bar.color = "black", matrix.color = "black", point.size = 3.2, line.size = 1, mb.ratio = c(0.65, 0.35), text.scale = c(1.6, 1.4, 1.4, 1.2, 1.5, 1.2), mainbar.y.label = "Intersection size", sets.x.label = "Set size")
  draw_upset <- function() { grid::grid.newpage(); print(upset_obj, newpage = FALSE); invisible(NULL) }
  upset_pdf <- file.path(upset_dir, "baseline_OVR_all7_UpSet.pdf"); upset_cairo <- file.path(upset_dir, "baseline_OVR_all7_UpSet_cairo.pdf"); upset_svg <- file.path(upset_dir, "baseline_OVR_all7_UpSet.svg"); upset_png <- file.path(upset_dir, "baseline_OVR_all7_UpSet.png"); upset_tiff <- file.path(upset_dir, "baseline_OVR_all7_UpSet.tiff")
  if (ovr_force_export || !file.exists(upset_pdf)) { grDevices::pdf(upset_pdf, width = 15, height = 7, family = "sans", useDingbats = FALSE); draw_upset(); dev.off() }
  if (ovr_export_cairo && (ovr_force_export || !file.exists(upset_cairo))) { grDevices::cairo_pdf(upset_cairo, width = 15, height = 7, family = "sans"); draw_upset(); dev.off() }
  if (ovr_force_export || !file.exists(upset_svg)) { svglite::svglite(upset_svg, width = 15, height = 7, bg = "white"); draw_upset(); dev.off() }
  if (ovr_force_export || !file.exists(upset_png)) { ragg::agg_png(upset_png, width = 15, height = 7, units = "in", res = 300, background = "white"); draw_upset(); dev.off() }
  if (ovr_export_tiff_600 && (ovr_force_export || !file.exists(upset_tiff))) { ragg::agg_tiff(upset_tiff, width = 15, height = 7, units = "in", res = 600, background = "white", compression = "lzw"); draw_upset(); dev.off() }
}
gc()
```

## Panel C: OVR full-matrix heatmap

```{r panel-C-ovr-fullmatrix-heatmap}

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(qs)
  library(Seurat)
  library(Matrix)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(mgcv)
  library(ComplexHeatmap)
  library(future)
  library(ragg)
})

source("/path/to/scRhythmBayes/reproducibility/support/legacy/liver_block_m3_heatmap.R")

future::plan(future::sequential)
options(future.globals.maxSize = 2 * 1024^3)

ovr_data_dir <- "/path/to/scRhythmBayes/data"
baseline_dir <- file.path(ovr_data_dir, "ovr_baseline")
figure_dir <- file.path(ovr_data_dir, "figure3_revision")
phase_file <- file.path(out_dir, "liver_phase.rds")

dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

pdf_file <- file.path(figure_dir, "panel_C_OVR_empirical_rank.pdf")
png_file <- file.path(figure_dir, "panel_C_OVR_empirical_rank.png")
rds_file <- file.path(figure_dir, "panel_C_OVR_empirical_rank.rds")
rank_file <- file.path(figure_dir, "panel_C_empirical_peak_rank_diagnostic.tsv")
summary_file <- file.path(figure_dir, "panel_C_empirical_peak_validation_summary.tsv")

baseline_files <- list.files(
  baseline_dir,
  pattern = "\\.rds$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

stopifnot(length(baseline_files) == 7L)

baseline_list <- lapply(
  baseline_files,
  readRDS
)

baseline_all <- bind_rows(
  lapply(
    baseline_list,
    function(x) x$ovr_result
  )
)

baseline_markers <- baseline_all %>%
  filter(ovr_marker) %>%
  distinct(celltype, gene, .keep_all = TRUE)

cat(
  "Baseline OVR assignments:",
  nrow(baseline_markers),
  "\n"
)

print(
  baseline_markers %>%
    count(celltype, name = "n_marker") %>%
    arrange(desc(n_marker))
)

phase_obj <- readRDS(phase_file)

cell_meta <- meta

rownames(cell_meta) <- as.character(
  cell_meta$cell
)

cell_meta$cell <- NULL

cell_meta <- cell_meta[
  colnames(count_mat),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

cell_meta$celltype <- as.character(
  cell_meta$celltype
)

phase_cells <- as.character(
  phase_obj$cell
)

phase_id <- match(
  rownames(cell_meta),
  phase_cells
)

stopifnot(
  !anyNA(phase_id)
)

cell_meta$theta_pred <- as.numeric(
  phase_obj$theta_pred[
    phase_id
  ]
)

stopifnot(
  all(is.finite(cell_meta$theta_pred)),
  !"cell" %in% colnames(cell_meta),
  identical(
    rownames(cell_meta),
    colnames(count_mat)
  )
)

wrap_phase <- function(x) {
  ((as.numeric(x) %% (2 * pi)) + 2 * pi) %% (2 * pi)
}

celltype_order <- c(
  "Hep.PV",
  "Hep.CV",
  "Endothelial",
  "Fibroblasts",
  "Kupffer cells",
  "Lymphocytes",
  "Cholangiocytes"
)

ovr_heatmap_df <- baseline_markers %>%
  transmute(
    gene = as.character(gene),
    TargetCellType = as.character(celltype),
    Phase_target = as.numeric(Phase_target),
    Phase_plot = wrap_phase(Phase_target),
    Module3_flag = TRUE
  ) %>%
  filter(
    gene %in% rownames(count_mat),
    TargetCellType %in% celltype_order,
    is.finite(Phase_plot)
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    TargetCellType,
    gene,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )

cat(
  "Genes entering heatmap:",
  nrow(ovr_heatmap_df),
  "\n"
)

full_library_size <- Matrix::colSums(
  count_mat
)

stopifnot(
  all(full_library_size > 0)
)

empirical_grid_hour <- seq(
  0,
  24,
  length.out = 121
)[-121]

peak_list <- vector(
  "list",
  length(celltype_order)
)

names(peak_list) <- celltype_order

for (ct in celltype_order) {

  genes_ct <- ovr_heatmap_df$gene[
    ovr_heatmap_df$TargetCellType == ct
  ]

  cells_ct <- rownames(cell_meta)[
    cell_meta$celltype == ct
  ]

  theta_hour <- wrap_phase(
    cell_meta[
      cells_ct,
      "theta_pred"
    ]
  ) / (2 * pi) * 24

  norm_factor <- 1e4 /
    full_library_size[
      cells_ct
    ]

  fit_dat <- data.frame(
    expr = numeric(
      length(cells_ct)
    ),
    theta_hour = theta_hour
  )

  peak_hour <- vapply(
    genes_ct,
    function(g) {

      fit_dat$expr <- log1p(
        as.numeric(
          count_mat[
            g,
            cells_ct,
            drop = TRUE
          ]
        ) * norm_factor
      )

      fit <- mgcv::gam(
        expr ~ s(
          theta_hour,
          bs = "cc",
          k = 8
        ),
        data = fit_dat,
        method = "REML",
        knots = list(
          theta_hour = c(
            0,
            24
          )
        )
      )

      pred <- as.numeric(
        predict(
          fit,
          newdata = data.frame(
            theta_hour = empirical_grid_hour
          )
        )
      )

      empirical_grid_hour[
        which.max(pred)
      ]
    },
    numeric(1)
  )

  peak_list[[ct]] <- tibble(
    TargetCellType = ct,
    gene = genes_ct,
    empirical_smooth_peak_hour = peak_hour
  )

  message(
    ct,
    ": ",
    length(genes_ct),
    " genes completed"
  )

  gc()
}

empirical_peak_df <- bind_rows(
  peak_list
)

ovr_heatmap_df_empirical <- ovr_heatmap_df %>%
  left_join(
    empirical_peak_df,
    by = c(
      "TargetCellType",
      "gene"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    model_phase_hour =
      Phase_plot /
      (2 * pi) *
      24,

    circular_error_hour =
      abs(
        (
          empirical_smooth_peak_hour -
          model_phase_hour +
          12
        ) %%
          24 -
          12
      ),

    empirical_phase_rad =
      empirical_smooth_peak_hour /
      24 *
      2 *
      pi,

    TargetCellType = factor(
      TargetCellType,
      levels = celltype_order
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    TargetCellType,
    empirical_smooth_peak_hour,
    gene
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    TargetCellType
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    phase_rank = row_number()
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    TargetCellType = as.character(
      TargetCellType
    )
  )

stopifnot(
  nrow(ovr_heatmap_df_empirical) ==
    nrow(ovr_heatmap_df),

  all(
    is.finite(
      ovr_heatmap_df_empirical$
        empirical_phase_rad
    )
  ),

  !anyDuplicated(
    ovr_heatmap_df_empirical[
      c(
        "TargetCellType",
        "gene"
      )
    ]
  )
)

empirical_rank_diagnostic <- ovr_heatmap_df_empirical %>%
  transmute(
    celltype = TargetCellType,
    gene,
    Phase_target,
    model_phase_hour,
    empirical_smooth_peak_hour,
    circular_error_hour,
    empirical_phase_rad,
    phase_rank
  )

write_tsv(
  empirical_rank_diagnostic,
  rank_file
)

phase_validation_summary <- empirical_rank_diagnostic %>%
  group_by(
    celltype
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),

    median_error_h =
      median(
        circular_error_hour,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    mean_error_h =
      mean(
        circular_error_hour,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    pct_within_2h =
      mean(
        circular_error_hour <= 2,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ) *
      100,

    pct_within_4h =
      mean(
        circular_error_hour <= 4,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ) *
      100,

    .groups = "drop"
  )

write_tsv(
  phase_validation_summary,
  summary_file
)

print(
  phase_validation_summary
)

heatmap_genes <- unique(
  ovr_heatmap_df_empirical$gene
)

heatmap_input_mat <- count_mat[
  heatmap_genes,
  ,

]

library_remainder <- pmax(

  )

heatmap_input_mat <- rbind(

stopifnot(

    )
  ) <

)

cat(

  "genes x",
  ncol(count_mat),

)

cat(

  nrow(heatmap_input_mat),
```

```{r panel-C-ovr-fullmatrix-heatmap}
make_equal_width_helper <- function(fun) {

  replace_grid <- function(x) {

    if (!is.call(x)) {
      return(x)
    }

    if (
      identical(x[[1]], as.name("<-")) &&
      identical(x[[2]], as.name("n_grid_use"))
    ) {
      return(
        quote(
          n_grid_use <- as.integer(n_grid)
        )
      )
    }

    as.call(
      lapply(
        x,
        replace_grid
      )
    )
  }

  fun_equal <- fun

  body(fun_equal) <- replace_grid(
    body(fun_equal)
  )

  fun_equal
}
```

## Panels D--E: FindAllMarkers and overlap

```{r panels-D-E-marker-comparison}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(Seurat); library(RColorBrewer)})
marker_dir <- file.path(figure_dir, "FindAllMarkers_celltype")
overlap_dir <- file.path(figure_dir, "OVR_vs_FindAllMarkers")
dir.create(marker_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE); dir.create(overlap_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

marker_celltype_levels <- meta %>% dplyr::mutate(celltype = as.character(celltype)) %>% dplyr::count(celltype, name = "n_cells") %>% dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n_cells), celltype) %>% dplyr::pull(celltype)
markers_cache <- file.path(marker_dir, "FindAllMarkers_all.tsv")
if (file.exists(markers_cache) && !ovr_force_recompute) {
  markers_all <- readr::read_tsv(markers_cache, show_col_types = FALSE)
} else {
  if (!ovr_allow_findall_recompute) stop("FindAllMarkers cache is absent. Set ovr_allow_findall_recompute <- TRUE to run this memory-intensive step once.")
  gc(full = TRUE)
  old_plan_findall <- future::plan(); future::plan(future::sequential)
  scliver_findall <- qread(scliver_file); DefaultAssay(scliver_findall) <- "RNA"
  scliver_findall <- NormalizeData(scliver_findall, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000, verbose = FALSE)
  scliver_findall$celltype <- factor(as.character(scliver_findall$celltype), levels = marker_celltype_levels)
  Idents(scliver_findall) <- "celltype"
  markers_all <- tryCatch(FindAllMarkers(scliver_findall, assay = "RNA", group.by = "celltype", logfc.threshold = 1, test.use = "wilcox", slot = "data", only.pos = TRUE, verbose = FALSE), finally = future::plan(old_plan_findall))
  rm(scliver_findall); gc(full = TRUE)
}
fc_col <- intersect(c("avg_log2FC", "avg_logFC"), names(markers_all))[1]

stopifnot(max(abs(Matrix::colSums(marker_count_mat) - marker_full_library_size)) < 1e-7)

rm(scliver_marker, marker_count_mat, marker_remainder_mat, marker_remainder, marker_full_library_size); gc(full = TRUE)

markers_sig <- markers_all %>% dplyr::filter(p_val_adj < 0.05, avg_log2FC > 1) %>% dplyr::transmute(cluster = as.character(cluster), gene = as.character(gene)) %>% dplyr::distinct()
ovr_sig <- baseline_markers %>% dplyr::transmute(celltype = as.character(celltype), gene = as.character(gene)) %>% dplyr::distinct()
celltype_levels <- c("Hep.PV", "Hep.CV", "Kupffer cells", "Fibroblasts", "Endothelial", "Lymphocytes", "Cholangiocytes")
overlap_list <- lapply(celltype_levels, function(ct) {
  genes_findall <- sort(unique(markers_sig$gene[markers_sig$cluster == ct])); genes_ovr <- sort(unique(ovr_sig$gene[ovr_sig$celltype == ct])); genes_intersect <- intersect(genes_findall, genes_ovr); genes_union <- union(genes_findall, genes_ovr)
  list(celltype = ct, findall = genes_findall, ovr = genes_ovr, summary = tibble(celltype = ct, n_FindAllMarkers = length(genes_findall), n_OVR = length(genes_ovr), n_intersect = length(genes_intersect), n_union = length(genes_union), n_FindAllMarkers_only = length(setdiff(genes_findall, genes_ovr)), n_OVR_only = length(setdiff(genes_ovr, genes_findall)), overlap_ratio_by_min = ifelse(min(length(genes_findall), length(genes_ovr)) > 0, length(genes_intersect) / min(length(genes_findall), length(genes_ovr)), NA_real_), jaccard = ifelse(length(genes_union) > 0, length(genes_intersect) / length(genes_union), NA_real_)))
})
summary_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(overlap_list, function(x) x$summary))
write_tsv(summary_df, file.path(overlap_dir, "OVR_vs_FindAllMarkers_overlap_summary.tsv"))

plot_two_set_venn <- function(x, title) {
  a <- length(x$findall); b <- length(x$ovr); i <- length(intersect(x$findall, x$ovr)); u <- length(union(x$findall, x$ovr)); fmt <- function(n) if (u == 0) as.character(n) else sprintf("%d\n(%.1f%%)", n, 100 * n / u)
  th <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 400); circles <- dplyr::bind_rows(tibble::tibble(set = "FindAllMarkers", x = -0.45 + 0.90 * cos(th), y = 0.78 * sin(th)), tibble::tibble(set = "OVR baseline", x = 0.45 + 0.90 * cos(th), y = 0.78 * sin(th)))
  ggplot(circles, aes(x, y, group = set, fill = set)) + geom_polygon(alpha = 0.55, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.8) + annotate("text", x = c(-0.62, 0, 0.62), y = 0, label = c(fmt(a - i), fmt(i), fmt(b - i)), size = 4.2, fontface = "bold") + annotate("text", x = c(-0.62, 0.62), y = 0.98, label = c("FindAllMarkers", "OVR baseline"), size = 3.5, fontface = "bold") + scale_fill_manual(values = c("FindAllMarkers" = "#E84D33", "OVR baseline" = "#55B3CF"), guide = "none") + coord_equal(xlim = c(-1.45, 1.45), ylim = c(-1.0, 1.18), clip = "off") + labs(title = title) + theme_void(base_family = "sans") + theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14), plot.margin = margin(8, 8, 8, 8), plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA), panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA))
}

for (x in overlap_list) {
  ct_tag <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", x$celltype)
  gene_table <- tibble::tibble(gene = sort(unique(c(x$findall, x$ovr)))) %>% dplyr::mutate(in_FindAllMarkers = gene %in% x$findall, in_OVR = gene %in% x$ovr, gene_class = dplyr::case_when(in_FindAllMarkers & in_OVR ~ "Intersect", in_FindAllMarkers ~ "FindAllMarkers_only", TRUE ~ "OVR_only"))
  write_tsv(gene_table, file.path(overlap_dir, paste0(ct_tag, "_gene_overlap_table.tsv")))

}
```

## Panel F: representative rhythmic curves

```{r panel-F-gene-curves}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(mgcv); library(Seurat)})
curve_dir <- file.path(figure_dir, "panel_F_gene_curves")
dir.create(curve_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

top5_celltypes <- baseline_stability %>% count(celltype, name = "n_marker") %>% arrange(desc(n_marker), celltype) %>% slice_head(n = 5)
candidate_top15 <- baseline_stability %>% filter(celltype %in% top5_celltypes$celltype) %>% mutate(delta_rank = coalesce(Delta_Amp, -Inf)) %>% group_by(celltype) %>% arrange(desc(support_n), FDR_target, desc(delta_rank), desc(Amplitude_target), Amplitude_rest, gene, .by_group = TRUE) %>% slice_head(n = 15) %>% mutate(rank_in_celltype = row_number()) %>% ungroup() %>% select(celltype, rank_in_celltype, gene, support_n, n_tested_loco, Amplitude_target, Amplitude_rest, Delta_Amp, Phase_target, Phase_rest, FDR_target, FDR_rest)
focus_genes_final <- sort(intersect(unique(candidate_top15$gene), rownames(count_mat)))
write_tsv(top5_celltypes, file.path(curve_dir, "top5_celltypes_by_baseline_marker_count.tsv")); write_tsv(candidate_top15, file.path(curve_dir, "candidate_top15.tsv")); write_tsv(tibble(gene = focus_genes_final), file.path(curve_dir, "focus_genes_final.tsv")); write_tsv(tibble(celltype = names(celltype_pal), color = unname(celltype_pal)), file.path(curve_dir, "celltype_color_key.tsv"))

phase_obj_curve <- if (exists("res_phase", inherits = TRUE)) get("res_phase", inherits = TRUE) else readRDS(file.path(out_dir, "liver_phase.rds"))
cell_meta_curve <- meta
rownames(cell_meta_curve) <- as.character(cell_meta_curve$cell)
cell_meta_curve$cell <- NULL
cell_meta_curve <- cell_meta_curve[colnames(count_mat), , drop = FALSE]
cell_meta_curve$theta_pred <- as.numeric(phase_obj_curve$theta_pred[match(rownames(cell_meta_curve), phase_obj_curve$cell)])
cell_meta_curve <- cell_meta_curve %>% rownames_to_column("cell") %>% mutate(celltype = factor(as.character(celltype), levels = celltype_levels), theta_hour = ((theta_pred / (2 * pi)) * 24) %% 24) %>% filter(is.finite(theta_hour), !is.na(celltype))

curve_library_size <- Matrix::colSums(count_mat)
stopifnot(all(curve_library_size > 0))
expr_data <- methods::as(count_mat[focus_genes_final, , drop = FALSE] %*% Matrix::Diagonal(x = 10000 / curve_library_size), "dgCMatrix")
expr_data@x <- log1p(expr_data@x)

fit_one_curve <- function(df_sub, n_grid = 300, k = 8) {
  grid <- seq(0, 24, length.out = n_grid)
  if (nrow(df_sub) < 20 || n_distinct(round(df_sub$theta_hour, 4)) < 6) return(tibble(theta_hour = numeric(), theta_pred = numeric(), expr_fit = numeric()))
  fit <- try(mgcv::gam(expr ~ s(theta_hour, bs = "cc", k = k), data = df_sub, method = "REML", knots = list(theta_hour = c(0, 24))), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(fit, "try-error")) return(tibble(theta_hour = numeric(), theta_pred = numeric(), expr_fit = numeric()))
  pred <- tryCatch(as.numeric(predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(theta_hour = grid))), error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, length(grid)))
  tibble(theta_hour = grid, theta_pred = grid / 24 * 2 * pi, expr_fit = pred)
}

for (gene_use in focus_genes_final) {
  gene_tag <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", gene_use)
  curve_source_file <- file.path(curve_dir, paste0(gene_tag, "_curve_source.tsv"))
  if (file.exists(curve_source_file) && !ovr_force_recompute) {
    cosinor_df <- readr::read_tsv(curve_source_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>% dplyr::mutate(celltype = factor(celltype, levels = celltype_levels))
  } else {
    gene_values <- as.numeric(expr_data[gene_use, cell_meta_curve$cell, drop = TRUE])
    gene_df <- cell_meta_curve %>% dplyr::mutate(expr = gene_values)
    cosinor_df <- gene_df %>% group_by(celltype) %>% group_modify(~fit_one_curve(.x)) %>% ungroup() %>% filter(is.finite(expr_fit))
    write_tsv(cosinor_df, curve_source_file)
  }
  if (nrow(cosinor_df) == 0) next
  p_gene <- ggplot(cosinor_df, aes(theta_pred, expr_fit, colour = celltype)) + geom_line(linewidth = 1.15) + scale_colour_manual(values = celltype_pal, drop = FALSE, name = NULL) + scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 2 * pi), breaks = c(0, pi/2, pi, 3*pi/2, 2*pi), labels = c("0", "π/2", "π", "3π/2", "2π"), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.03))) + labs(title = gene_use, x = expression("Predicted phase " * phi), y = "Normalized expression") + theme_ovr(10) + theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 14), legend.position = "none")
  save_gg(p_gene, file.path(curve_dir, paste0("OVR_7celltypes_", gene_tag, "_curve")), 4.8, 4.4)
}
rm(expr_data, curve_library_size); gc(full = TRUE)
```

```{r panel-F-gene-curves}
fit_one_curve <- function(
  df_sub,
  n_grid = 300,
  k = 8
) {

  grid <- seq(
    0,
    24,
    length.out = n_grid
  )

  if (
    nrow(df_sub) < 20 ||
    dplyr::n_distinct(
      round(df_sub$theta_hour, 4)
    ) < 6
  ) {
    return(
      tibble::tibble(
        theta_hour = numeric(),
        theta_pred = numeric(),
        expr_fit = numeric()
      )
    )
  }

  fit <- try(
    mgcv::gam(
      expr ~ s(
        theta_hour,
        bs = "cc",
        k = k
      ),
      data = df_sub,
      method = "REML",
      knots = list(
        theta_hour = c(0, 24)
      )
    ),
    silent = TRUE
  )

  if (inherits(fit, "try-error")) {
    return(
      tibble::tibble(
        theta_hour = numeric(),
        theta_pred = numeric(),
        expr_fit = numeric()
      )
    )
  }

  pred <- tryCatch(
    as.numeric(
      stats::predict(
        fit,
        newdata = data.frame(
          theta_hour = grid
        )
      )
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      rep(
        NA_real_,
        length(grid)
      )
    }
  )

  tibble::tibble(
    theta_hour = grid,
    theta_pred = grid / 24 * 2 * pi,
    expr_fit = pred
  )
}
```

```{r panel-F-gene-curves}
fit_one_curve <- function(
  df_sub,
  n_grid = 300,
  k = 8
) {

  grid <- seq(
    0,
    24,
    length.out = n_grid
  )

  if (
    nrow(df_sub) < 20 ||
    dplyr::n_distinct(
      round(
        df_sub$theta_hour,
        4
      )
    ) < 6
  ) {
    return(
      tibble::tibble(
        theta_hour = numeric(),
        theta_pred = numeric(),
        expr_fit = numeric()
      )
    )
  }

  fit <- try(
    mgcv::gam(
      expr ~ s(
        theta_hour,
        bs = "cc",
        k = k
      ),
      data = df_sub,
      method = "REML",
      knots = list(
        theta_hour = c(
          0,
          24
        )
      )
    ),
    silent = TRUE
  )

  if (
    inherits(
      fit,
      "try-error"
    )
  ) {
    return(
      tibble::tibble(
        theta_hour = numeric(),
        theta_pred = numeric(),
        expr_fit = numeric()
      )
    )
  }

  pred <- tryCatch(
    as.numeric(
      stats::predict(
        fit,
        newdata = data.frame(
          theta_hour = grid
        )
      )
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      rep(
        NA_real_,
        length(grid)
      )
    }
  )

  tibble::tibble(
    theta_hour = grid,
    theta_pred = grid /
      24 *
      2 *
      pi,
    expr_fit = pred
  )
}

}
```

```{r panel-F-target-vs-rest-curves}
fit_curve <- function(df_sub, n_grid = 300, k = 8) {

  grid <- seq(0, 24, length.out = n_grid)

  if (
    nrow(df_sub) < 20 ||
    dplyr::n_distinct(round(df_sub$theta_hour, 4)) < 6
  ) {
    return(
      tibble::tibble(
        theta_hour = numeric(),
        expr_fit = numeric()
      )
    )
  }

  fit <- try(
    mgcv::gam(
      expr ~ s(theta_hour, bs = "cc", k = k),
      data = df_sub,
      method = "REML",
      knots = list(theta_hour = c(0, 24))
    ),
    silent = TRUE
  )

  if (inherits(fit, "try-error")) {
    return(
      tibble::tibble(
        theta_hour = numeric(),
        expr_fit = numeric()
      )
    )
  }

  pred <- tryCatch(
    as.numeric(
      stats::predict(
        fit,
        newdata = data.frame(theta_hour = grid)
      )
    ),
    error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, length(grid))
  )

  tibble::tibble(
    theta_hour = grid,
    expr_fit = pred
  )
}

  gene_use <- candidate_top15$gene[i]
  target_ct <- candidate_top15$celltype[i]

  gene_df <- cell_meta_curve %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      expr = gene_values,
      group_plot = ifelse(
        celltype == target_ct,
        "Target",
        "Rest"
      )

  curve_df <- gene_df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(group_plot) %>%
    dplyr::group_modify(
      ~ fit_curve(
        .x,
        n_grid = 300,
        k = 8

    celltype_pal_curve[target_ct]
  )

  curve_df$group_plot <- factor(
    curve_df$group_plot,
    levels = c("Rest", "Target")
  )

  p_gene <- ggplot() +
    geom_line(
      data = dplyr::filter(
        curve_df,
        group_plot == "Rest"
      ),
      aes(
        x = theta_hour,
        y = expr_fit
      ),
      colour = "#6F6F6F",
      linewidth = 1.3,
      linetype = "22",
      lineend = "round"
    ) +
    geom_line(
      data = dplyr::filter(
        curve_df,
        group_plot == "Target"
      ),
      aes(
        x = theta_hour,
        y = expr_fit
      ),
      colour = target_color,
      linewidth = 2.0,
      lineend = "round"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 24),
      breaks = c(0, 6, 12, 18, 24),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.02))
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.04, 0.12))
    ) +
    labs(
      title = gene_use,
      subtitle = target_ct,
      x = "Predicted phase (h)",
      y = "Normalized expression"
    ) +
    theme_classic(
      base_size = 11,
      base_family = "sans"
    ) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0.5,
        size = 22,
        margin = margin(b = 1)
      ),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        colour = target_color,
        hjust = 0.5,
        size = 11,
        margin = margin(b = 4)
      ),
      axis.title.x = element_text(
        size = 11.5,
        face = "bold",
        margin = margin(t = 5)
      ),
      axis.title.y = element_text(
        size = 11.5,
        face = "bold",
        margin = margin(r = 5)
      ),
      axis.text = element_text(
        size = 10,
        colour = "black"
      ),
      axis.line = element_line(
        linewidth = 0.6,
        colour = "black"
      ),
      axis.ticks = element_line(
        linewidth = 0.5,
        colour = "black"
      ),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.margin = margin(7, 7, 7, 7)
    )

  gene_tag <- gsub(
    "[^A-Za-z0-9]+",
    "_",
    gene_use
  )

  ct_tag <- gsub(
    "[^A-Za-z0-9]+",
    "_",
    target_ct
  )

  file_stub <- paste0(
    sprintf("%02d", rank_use),
    "_",
    ct_tag,
    "_",
    gene_tag
  )

  readr::write_tsv(
    curve_df,
    file.path(
      curve_dir,
      paste0(
        file_stub,
        "_curve_source.tsv"
      )
    )
  )

  ggsave(
    file.path(
      curve_dir,
      paste0(
        file_stub,
        "_Target_vs_Rest.pdf"
      )
    ),
    p_gene,
    width = 3.8,
    height = 3.8,
    units = "in",
    device = grDevices::pdf,
    bg = "white",
    useDingbats = FALSE
  )

  ggsave(
    file.path(
      curve_dir,
      paste0(
        file_stub,
        "_Target_vs_Rest.png"
      )
    ),
    p_gene,
    width = 3.8,
    height = 3.8,
    units = "in",
    dpi = 300,
    device = ragg::agg_png,
    bg = "white"
  )

  print(p_gene)
}
```

```{r panel-F-model-fitted-target-vs-rest}
make_model_curve <- function(
  amplitude,
  phase,
  n_grid = 400
) {

  theta_hour <- seq(
    0,
    24,
    length.out = n_grid
  )

  theta_rad <- theta_hour /
    24 *
    2 *
    pi

  eta_relative <- amplitude *
    cos(
      theta_rad -
        phase
    )

  expression_relative <- exp(
    eta_relative
  )

  expression_relative <- expression_relative /
    mean(
      expression_relative
    )

  tibble::tibble(
    theta_hour = theta_hour,
    expr_fit = expression_relative
  )
}

get_curve_file <- function(
  gene,
  celltype,
  rank
) {

  gene_tag <- gsub(
    "[^A-Za-z0-9]+",
    "_",
    gene
  )

  ct_tag <- gsub(
    "[^A-Za-z0-9]+",
    "_",
    celltype
  )

  file.path(
    curve_dir,
    paste0(
      sprintf(
        "%02d",
        rank
      ),
      "_",
      ct_tag,
      "_",
      gene_tag,
      "_Target_vs_Rest.png"
    )
  )
}

make_one_overview_panel <- function(
  image_file,
  rank
) {

  img <- magick::image_read(
    image_file
  )

  img <- magick::image_resize(
    img,
    "420x420!"
  )

  img <- magick::image_extent(
    img,
    geometry = "440x440",
    gravity = "center",
    color = "white"
  )

  img <- magick::image_annotate(
    img,
    paste0(
      "#",
      rank
    ),
    gravity = "northwest",
    location = "+8+8",
    size = 24,
    weight = 700,
    color = "black",
    boxcolor = "white"
  )

  img
}

make_celltype_column <- function(
  ct
) {

  df_ct <- candidate_overview %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      as.character(celltype) == ct
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      rank_in_celltype
    )

  imgs <- lapply(
    seq_len(
      nrow(df_ct)
    ),
    function(i) {

      make_one_overview_panel(
        df_ct$image_file[i],
        df_ct$rank_in_celltype[i]
      )
    }
  )

  body <- magick::image_append(
    do.call(
      c,
      imgs
    ),
    stack = TRUE
  )

  header <- magick::image_blank(
    width = magick::image_info(
      body
    )$width,
    height = 80,
    color = "white"
  )

  header <- magick::image_annotate(
    header,
    ct,
    gravity = "center",
    size = 34,
    weight = 700,
    color = "black"
  )

  magick::image_append(
    c(
      header,
      body
    ),
    stack = TRUE
  )
}
```

```{r}
      make_one_panel(
        df_ct$image_file[i],
        df_ct$rank_in_celltype[i]
      )
    }
  )

  body <- magick::image_append(
    do.call(c, imgs),
    stack = TRUE
  )

  header <- magick::image_blank(
    width = magick::image_info(body)$width,
    height = 80,
    color = "white"
  )

  header <- magick::image_annotate(
    header,
    ct,
    gravity = "center",
    size = 34,
    weight = 700,
    color = "black"
  )

  whole_column <- magick::image_append(
    c(
      header,
      body
    ),
    stack = TRUE
  )

  whole_column
}

celltype_columns <- lapply(
  overview_celltypes,
  make_celltype_column
)
```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({

make_celltype_strip <- function(ct) {

  df_ct <- candidate_images %>%
    filter(celltype == ct) %>%
    arrange(rank_in_celltype)

  imgs <- lapply(
    seq_len(nrow(df_ct)),
    function(i) {

      img <- image_read(
        df_ct$image_file[i]
      )

      img <- image_resize(
        img,
        "420x420"
      )

      img <- image_border(
        img,
        color = "white",
        geometry = "4x4"
      )

      img
    }
  )

  body <- image_append(
    do.call(c, imgs),
    stack = TRUE
  )

  header <- image_blank(
    width = image_info(body)$width,
    height = 70,
    color = "white"
  ) %>%
    image_annotate(
      ct,
      gravity = "center",
      size = 34,
      weight = 700,
      color = "black"
    )

  image_append(
    c(
      header,
      body
    ),
    stack = TRUE
  )
}
```

## Reactome enrichment

```{r reactome-enrichment}
reactome_pkgs <- c("clusterProfiler", "org.Mm.eg.db", "ReactomePA")
if (!all(vapply(reactome_pkgs, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE))) {
  message("Reactome chunk skipped. Install missing Bioconductor packages: ", paste(reactome_pkgs[!vapply(reactome_pkgs, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)], collapse = ", "))
} else {
  reactome_dir <- file.path(figure_dir, "Reactome_baseline_OVR_by_celltype"); dir.create(reactome_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  ovr_reactome <- baseline_all %>% dplyr::transmute(TargetCellType = as.character(celltype), gene = as.character(gene), Module3_flag = as.logical(ovr_marker)) %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(TargetCellType), !is.na(gene), gene != "")
  celltype_order_reactome <- ovr_reactome %>% dplyr::filter(Module3_flag) %>% dplyr::count(TargetCellType, name = "n_M3") %>% dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n_M3)) %>% dplyr::pull(TargetCellType) %>% unique()

  symbol_to_entrez <- function(gene_vec) {
    gene_vec <- unique(as.character(gene_vec)); gene_vec <- gene_vec[!is.na(gene_vec) & gene_vec != ""]
    if (length(gene_vec) == 0) return(tibble::tibble(SYMBOL = character(0), ENTREZID = character(0)))
    out <- tryCatch(suppressWarnings(clusterProfiler::bitr(gene_vec, fromType = "SYMBOL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db::org.Mm.eg.db)), error = function(e) tibble::tibble(SYMBOL = character(0), ENTREZID = character(0)))
    out %>% dplyr::distinct(SYMBOL, ENTREZID)
  }
  reactome_stat_cache <- file.path(reactome_dir, "Reactome_celltype_gene_stat_all.tsv"); reactome_summary_cache <- file.path(reactome_dir, "Reactome_celltype_summary.tsv"); reactome_all_cache <- file.path(reactome_dir, "Reactome_celltype_all.tsv")
  reactome_cache_ready <- all(file.exists(c(reactome_stat_cache, reactome_summary_cache, reactome_all_cache))) && !ovr_force_recompute
  symbol_map_all <- if (reactome_cache_ready) NULL else symbol_to_entrez(unique(ovr_reactome$gene))

  run_one_celltype_reactome <- function(ct_use) {
    message("Running Reactome for: ", ct_use)
    df_ct <- ovr_reactome %>% dplyr::filter(TargetCellType == ct_use)
    genes_fg_symbol <- df_ct %>% dplyr::filter(Module3_flag) %>% dplyr::pull(gene) %>% unique() %>% sort()
    genes_bg_symbol <- df_ct %>% dplyr::pull(gene) %>% unique() %>% sort()
    fg_map <- symbol_map_all %>% dplyr::filter(SYMBOL %in% genes_fg_symbol); bg_map <- symbol_map_all %>% dplyr::filter(SYMBOL %in% genes_bg_symbol)
    genes_fg_entrez <- unique(fg_map$ENTREZID); genes_bg_entrez <- unique(bg_map$ENTREZID)
    stat_df <- tibble::tibble(TargetCellType = ct_use, n_fg_symbol = length(genes_fg_symbol), n_bg_symbol = length(genes_bg_symbol), n_fg_entrez = length(genes_fg_entrez), n_bg_entrez = length(genes_bg_entrez))
    readr::write_tsv(stat_df, file.path(reactome_dir, paste0(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", ct_use), "_gene_stat.tsv")))
    if (length(genes_fg_entrez) < 10 || length(genes_bg_entrez) < 10) {
      summary_df <- stat_df %>% dplyr::mutate(n_terms_raw_p_lt_0_05 = 0L, n_terms_padj_lt_0_05 = 0L, status = "too_few_genes")
      return(list(stat = stat_df, summary = summary_df, reactome = tibble::tibble()))
    }
    ego_rt <- tryCatch(ReactomePA::enrichPathway(gene = genes_fg_entrez, organism = "mouse", pvalueCutoff = 0.05, pAdjustMethod = "BH", qvalueCutoff = 0.20, universe = genes_bg_entrez, readable = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(ego_rt)) {
      summary_df <- stat_df %>% dplyr::mutate(n_terms_raw_p_lt_0_05 = 0L, n_terms_padj_lt_0_05 = 0L, status = "enrichPathway_failed")
      return(list(stat = stat_df, summary = summary_df, reactome = tibble::tibble()))
    }
    res_rt <- ego_rt@result %>% tibble::as_tibble()
    if (nrow(res_rt) == 0) {
      summary_df <- stat_df %>% dplyr::mutate(n_terms_raw_p_lt_0_05 = 0L, n_terms_padj_lt_0_05 = 0L, status = "no_terms")
      return(list(stat = stat_df, summary = summary_df, reactome = tibble::tibble()))
    }
    res_rt <- res_rt %>% dplyr::mutate(TargetCellType = ct_use)
    readr::write_tsv(res_rt, file.path(reactome_dir, paste0(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", ct_use), "_Reactome_full.tsv")))
    summary_df <- stat_df %>% dplyr::mutate(n_terms_raw_p_lt_0_05 = sum(res_rt$pvalue < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), n_terms_padj_lt_0_05 = sum(res_rt$p.adjust < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), status = "ok")
    list(stat = stat_df, summary = summary_df, reactome = res_rt)
  }

  if (reactome_cache_ready) {
    stat_all <- readr::read_tsv(reactome_stat_cache, show_col_types = FALSE); summary_all <- readr::read_tsv(reactome_summary_cache, show_col_types = FALSE); reactome_all_df <- readr::read_tsv(reactome_all_cache, show_col_types = FALSE)
  } else {
    res_list <- setNames(lapply(celltype_order_reactome, run_one_celltype_reactome), celltype_order_reactome)
    stat_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(res_list, function(x) x$stat)); summary_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(res_list, function(x) x$summary)); reactome_all_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(res_list, function(x) x$reactome))
    readr::write_tsv(stat_all, reactome_stat_cache); readr::write_tsv(summary_all, reactome_summary_cache)
    if (nrow(reactome_all_df) > 0) readr::write_tsv(reactome_all_df, reactome_all_cache) else readr::write_tsv(tibble::tibble(TargetCellType = character()), reactome_all_cache)
  }

  if (nrow(reactome_all_df) == 0) {
    message("No significant Reactome pathways found for plotting.")
  } else {
    use_pathway <- reactome_all_df %>% dplyr::group_by(TargetCellType) %>% dplyr::arrange(p.adjust, dplyr::desc(Count), .by_group = TRUE) %>% dplyr::slice_head(n = 5) %>% dplyr::ungroup() %>% dplyr::mutate(celltype_show = TargetCellType, neglog10_p = -log10(pmax(pvalue, .Machine$double.xmin)), Description_wrapped = stringr::str_wrap(Description, width = 60))
    readr::write_tsv(use_pathway, file.path(reactome_dir, "Reactome_celltype_top5_for_plot.tsv"))
    celltype_plot_order <- setdiff(celltype_order_reactome, "Cholangiocytes")
    use_pathway <- use_pathway %>% dplyr::filter(celltype_show %in% celltype_plot_order) %>% dplyr::mutate(celltype_show = factor(celltype_show, levels = celltype_plot_order)) %>% dplyr::arrange(celltype_show, p.adjust, dplyr::desc(Count)) %>% dplyr::mutate(y_show_chr = make.unique(as.character(Description_wrapped)), y_show = factor(y_show_chr, levels = rev(y_show_chr)))
    if (nrow(use_pathway) == 0) {
      message("Reactome terms were found, but none remained after the original Cholangiocytes display exclusion.")
    } else {
      width <- 0.55; xaxis_max <- ceiling(max(use_pathway$neglog10_p, na.rm = TRUE) + 1)
      rect.data <- use_pathway %>% dplyr::count(celltype_show, name = "n", .drop = FALSE) %>% dplyr::filter(n > 0) %>% dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(celltype_show)) %>% dplyr::mutate(xmin = -3.2 * width, xmax = -2.0 * width, ymax = cumsum(n), ymin = dplyr::lag(ymax, default = 0) + 0.8, ymax = ymax + 0.6)
      p_celltype_all <- ggplot(use_pathway, aes(x = neglog10_p, y = y_show, fill = celltype_show)) + geom_col(width = 1, alpha = 0.5) + geom_text(aes(x = 0.08, label = Description_wrapped), hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, size = 5.2, fontface = "bold", color = "black") + geom_point(aes(x = -width, size = Count), shape = 21, stroke = 0.6, fill = "white", color = "black") + geom_text(aes(x = -width, label = Count), vjust = 0.5, size = 4, fontface = "bold") + scale_size_continuous(name = "Count", range = c(4.5, 12)) + geom_rect(data = rect.data, aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, fill = celltype_show), alpha = 0.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) + geom_text(data = rect.data, aes(x = (xmin + xmax) / 2, y = (ymin + ymax) / 2, label = celltype_show), inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 4.2, fontface = "bold", angle = 90) + geom_segment(x = 0, y = 0, xend = xaxis_max, yend = 0, linewidth = 1.2, inherit.aes = FALSE) + labs(x = expression(-log[10](pvalue)), y = NULL, title = "Top enriched Reactome pathways across liver cell types") + scale_fill_manual(name = "Cell type", values = celltype_pal[celltype_plot_order]) + scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, xaxis_max, by = 2), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))) + coord_cartesian(clip = "off") + theme_bw() + theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"), axis.text.x = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"), axis.line.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), legend.title = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"), legend.text = element_text(size = 13), plot.title = element_text(size = 28, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5), plot.margin = margin(15, 20, 40, 20))
      print(p_celltype_all); save_gg(p_celltype_all, file.path(reactome_dir, "Reactome_celltype_all_top5_summary"), 16.8, 15)
    }
  }
}
```
